frontmatter.title: Cognitive Offloading vs Cognitive Surrender: One Makes Sense, the Other Doesn't
frontmatter.description: Cognitive offloading is smart. Cognitive surrender is dangerous. A Wharton study of 1,372 people shows most of us have stopped telling the difference.
